title: Curry Fish with Honey Glaze
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish that combines the flavors of curry and honey.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Any white fish works well, such as cod or tilapia.

instructions: Season fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix honey and curry powder in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the honey-curry glaze over the fish.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized.
